searchText: Which clients supports staked builder API for devnet-8, would that feature be tested, we should have something in Teku early next week prysm ok I have some validators online now, am I allowed to do anything I want with that 10k ETH, or is there some "policy" we have about not attacking this network? I obviously won't touch any lodestar ethpandaops nodes/validators to help me exploit stuff, those stay honest yeah try to break anything lol but it’s all fulu so if you broke something pls keep tight lipped lol Ha thanks for asking. I was sort of wondering the same thing. I've already submitted more than `MAX_BUILDER_DEPOSIT_REQUESTS_PER_PAYLOAD` to the builder deposit contract, to ensure the first slot post-upgrade will be full. This builder will also use the same pubkey as my validator. I was thinking we should ensure a new builder is onboarded (and active) at the fork _and_ there's a builder exit request for that builder in the first slot post-upgrade. That's why I haven't submitted anything to the exit contract yet. Post-upgrade, I plan to... * spam bids with 1k+ unique builders. * send various invalid bids. * send a builder deposit/exit request for the same builder in the same block. * send various invalid builder deposit/exit requests, to test each check. * ensure builder index re-use works. I think it's fair game to even use the official lodestar nodes as long as it's very public what you're doing cause we may be using also Lodestar's actions to diagnose the chain. I actually think we should keep those as-is. We wanna keep our nodes untouched for this testnet We can do NFT testnet for crazy attacks and unfinality sounds good but I really wanna get stability out of this chain so app devs can start testing and hopefully fully understand all the repricing eips Oh wait. So we shouldn't try to break things? Err with a small subset of validators individuals operate. yeah I think Barnabas is fine breaking things externally just not with our larger stable set that we can control to bring back to stability yeah exactly
